english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a lawsuit or court case.
Use this for a lawsuit or legal case in ordinary spoken Cantonese.

examples.english: This lawsuit has been going on for a year and still isn't over.
examples.traditional: 呢單官司打咗成年，仲未完。
examples.jyutping: ne1 daan1 gun1 si1 daa2 zo2 seng4 nin4 zung6 mei6 jyun4

examples.english: I don’t want to get embroiled in a legal suit with him.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 m4 soeng2 tung4 keoi5 daa2 gun1 si1
